```{r}
genesets_mouse <- c('Sox10','Erbb3', "Myt1","Gpr17","Slc1a1",'Tgfbi','Col5a1','Adamts2',"Itga4", "Igfbp3","Egfr",'Elovl2', 'Robo2','Bmpr1b','Slc7a11')

genesets_human <- c('SOX10','ERBB3',"MYT1", "GPR17",'CA10',"TGFBI", "COL5A1", "ADAMTS2", "ITGA4", "IGFBP3","EGFR",'ELOVL2','ROBO2','BMPR1B', "SPRY2")
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)


# --- signatures as named lists (human example) ---
sig_human <- list(
  PN  = c("SOX10","ERBB3","MYT1","GPR17","CA10"),
  MES = c("TGFBI","COL5A1","ADAMTS2","ITGA4","IGFBP3"),
  CL  = c("EGFR","ELOVL2","ROBO2","BMPR1B","SPRY2")
)

DefaultAssay(hGlio) <- "RNA"   # score on RNA, not ATAC

# --- add one module score per signature ---
hGlio <- AddModuleScore(hGlio, features = sig_human,
                        name = "sig_", seed = 62)
# creates columns sig_1, sig_2, sig_3 in the order of the list (PN, MES, CL)

# rename IN THE OBJECT so score_* columns are usable downstream (FeaturePlot)
idx <- match(c("sig_1","sig_2","sig_3"), colnames(hGlio@meta.data))
colnames(hGlio@meta.data)[idx] <- c("score_PN","score_MES","score_CL")

# --- average each score within each assigned subtype ---
subtype_col <- "Duy_clusters"   # <-- replace with your actual metadata column name

tab_human <- hGlio@meta.data %>%
  group_by(.data[[subtype_col]]) %>%
  summarise(PN  = mean(score_PN),
            MES = mean(score_MES),
            CL  = mean(score_CL), .groups = "drop") %>%
  column_to_rownames(subtype_col)
lvl_row <- c("PN","MES","CL","MIX")   # row order (subtypes)
lvl_col <- c("PN","MES","CL")          # column order (signatures)

tab_human <- tab_human[lvl_row, lvl_col]  
tab_human   # this is your 4x3 table (rows: PN/MES/CL/MIX, cols: signatures)

```

```{r mglio scoring}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# --- mouse signatures (species-appropriate symbols) ---
sig_mouse <- list(
  PN  = c("Sox10","Erbb3","Myt1","Gpr17","Slc1a1"),
  MES = c("Tgfbi","Col5a1","Adamts2","Itga4","Igfbp3"),
  CL  = c("Egfr","Elovl2","Robo2","Bmpr1b","Slc7a11")
)

DefaultAssay(mGlio) <- "RNA"   # score on RNA, not ATAC

# --- add one module score per signature ---
mGlio <- AddModuleScore(mGlio, features = sig_mouse,
                        name = "sig_", seed = 62)
# creates sig_1, sig_2, sig_3 in list order: PN, MES, CL

# --- rename IN THE OBJECT ---
idx <- match(c("sig_1","sig_2","sig_3"), colnames(mGlio@meta.data))
colnames(mGlio@meta.data)[idx] <- c("score_PN","score_MES","score_CL")

# --- average each score within each assigned subtype ---
subtype_col <- "Duy_clusters"   # <-- replace with your ACTUAL mouse metadata column name

tab_mouse <- mGlio@meta.data %>%
  group_by(.data[[subtype_col]]) %>%
  summarise(PN  = mean(score_PN),
            MES = mean(score_MES),
            CL  = mean(score_CL), .groups = "drop") %>%
  column_to_rownames(subtype_col)

# --- enforce matching row/column order so the diagonal reads as a diagonal ---
lvl_row <- c("PN","MES","CL","MIX")
lvl_col <- c("PN","MES","CL")
tab_mouse <- tab_mouse[lvl_row, lvl_col]

tab_mouse   # eyeball before plotting

```

```{r score heatmaps, fig.width= 6, fig.height = 3}
library(pheatmap)
library(viridisLite)

# shared range across both species so the two heatmaps are directly comparable
rng <- range(c(as.matrix(tab_mouse), as.matrix(tab_human)))
brk <- seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 101)

score_heatmap_human <- pheatmap(as.matrix(tab_human),
         cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         fontsize_number = 12,
         number_color = "grey80",
         color = rev(inferno(100)),
         breaks = brk)

score_heatmap_mouse <- pheatmap(as.matrix(tab_mouse),
         cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         fontsize_number = 12,
         number_color = "grey80",
         color = rev(inferno(100)),
         breaks = brk)

ggsave("pheatmap_modulescore_hGlio.png", plot = score_heatmap_human, dpi = 300,
       width = 6, height = 4, units = "in")
ggsave("pheatmap_modulescore_mGlio.png", plot = score_heatmap_mouse, dpi = 300,
       width = 6, height = 4, units = "in")
```

```{r module score featureplots}
# helper: one FeaturePlot + one ggsave per score, diverging scale centred at 0
plot_score <- function(obj, score, prefix, reduction = "wnn.umap", dpi = 300) {
  lim <- max(abs(obj@meta.data[[score]]))
  p <- FeaturePlot(obj, features = score, reduction = reduction, order = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = magma(100), name = "score")
  ggsave(paste0(prefix, "_modulescore_", sub("score_", "", score), "_umap.png"),
         plot = p, dpi = dpi, width = 5, height = 4, units = "in")
  p
}

# confirm the reduction name first: names(hGlio@reductions) / names(mGlio@reductions)

# human
plot_score(hGlio, "score_PN",  "hGlio")

plot_score(hGlio, "score_MES", "hGlio")
plot_score(hGlio, "score_CL",  "hGlio")

# mouse
plot_score(mGlio, "score_PN",  "mGlio")
plot_score(mGlio, "score_MES", "mGlio")
plot_score(mGlio, "score_CL",  "mGlio")
```

```{r}
subtype_order <- c("Proneural", "Mesenchymal", "Classical", "MIX")

mGlio$Duy_clusters <- factor(mGlio$Duy_clusters, levels = subtype_order)
hGlio$Duy_clusters  <- factor(hGlio$Duy_clusters,  levels = subtype_order)

mouse_genes <- c('Sox10','Erbb3','Myt1','Gpr17','Slc1a1',
                  'Tgfbi','Col5a1','Adamts2','Itga4','Igfbp3',
                  'Egfr','Elovl2','Robo2','Bmpr1b','Slc7a11')

human_genes <- c('SOX10','ERBB3','MYT1','GPR17','CA10',
                   'TGFBI','COL5A1','ADAMTS2','ITGA4','IGFBP3',
                   'EGFR','ELOVL2','ROBO2','BMPR1B','SPRY2')

mGlio <- ScaleData(mGlio, features = mouse_genes, assay = "RNA")
hGlio <- ScaleData(hGlio, features = human_genes, assay = "RNA")

p_mouse <- DoHeatmap(subset(mGlio, downsample = 300), features = mouse_genes,
                      group.by = "Duy_clusters", assay = "RNA") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#2166AC","white","#B2182B"), limits = c(-2, 2))

p_human <- DoHeatmap(subset(hGlio, downsample = 300), features = human_genes,
                      group.by = "Duy_clusters", assay = "RNA") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#2166AC","white","#B2182B"), limits = c(-2, 2))
```

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)




```{r Find Markers human & mouse histone modifiers }
# Filter to genes actually present in RNA assay
Idents(hGlio) <- "Duy_clusters"
available_genes_human <- rownames(hGlio@assays$RNA)
genes_to_test_human   <- unlist(histone_modifiers_human, use.names = FALSE)[
  unlist(histone_modifiers_human, use.names = FALSE) %in% available_genes_human]

# Run FindMarkers per cluster - Human
markers_list_human <- list()
for (cluster in levels(Idents(hGlio))) {
  markers <- tryCatch(
    FindMarkers(
      hGlio,
      ident.1         = cluster,
      assay           = "RNA",
      features        = genes_to_test_human,
      logfc.threshold = -Inf,
      min.pct         = 0,
      test.use        = "wilcox"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(markers) && nrow(markers) > 0) {
    markers$cluster <- cluster
    markers$gene    <- rownames(markers)
    markers_list_human[[cluster]] <- markers
  }
}
hist_markers_human <- do.call(rbind, markers_list_human)
rownames(hist_markers_human) <- NULL

# Filter to genes actually present in RNA assay
Idents(mGlio) <- "Duy_clusters"
available_genes_mouse <- rownames(mGlio@assays$RNA)
genes_to_test_mouse   <- unlist(histone_modifiers_mouse, use.names = FALSE)[
  unlist(histone_modifiers_mouse, use.names = FALSE) %in% available_genes_mouse]

# Run FindMarkers per cluster - Mouse
markers_list_mouse <- list()
for (cluster in levels(Idents(mGlio))) {
  markers <- tryCatch(
    FindMarkers(
      mGlio,
      ident.1         = cluster,
      assay           = "RNA",
      features        = genes_to_test_mouse,
      logfc.threshold = -Inf,
      min.pct         = 0,
      test.use        = "wilcox"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(markers) && nrow(markers) > 0) {
    markers$cluster <- cluster
    markers$gene    <- rownames(markers)
    markers_list_mouse[[cluster]] <- markers
  }
}
hist_markers_mouse <- do.call(rbind, markers_list_mouse)
rownames(hist_markers_mouse) <- NULL
```


```{r Find Markers human & mouse chromatin modifiers }
# Filter to genes actually present in RNA assay
Idents(hGlio) <- "Duy_clusters"
available_genes_human <- rownames(hGlio@assays$RNA)
chrom_genes_to_test_human   <- unique(unlist(chromatin_complexes_human, use.names = FALSE)[
  unlist(chromatin_complexes_human, use.names = FALSE) %in% available_genes_human])

# Run FindMarkers per cluster - Human
markers_list_human <- list()
for (cluster in levels(Idents(hGlio))) {
  markers <- tryCatch(
    FindMarkers(
      hGlio,
      ident.1         = cluster,
      assay           = "RNA",
      features        = chrom_genes_to_test_human,
      logfc.threshold = -Inf,
      min.pct         = 0,
      test.use        = "wilcox"
    ),
    error = function(e) { message("Cluster ", cluster, ": ", e$message); NULL}
  )
  if (!is.null(markers) && nrow(markers) > 0) {
    markers$cluster <- cluster
    markers$gene    <- rownames(markers)
    markers_list_human[[cluster]] <- markers
  }
}
chrom_markers_human <- do.call(rbind, markers_list_human)
rownames(chrom_markers_human) <- NULL

# Filter to genes actually present in RNA assay
Idents(mGlio) <- "Duy_clusters"
available_genes_mouse <- rownames(mGlio@assays$RNA)
chrom_genes_to_test_mouse   <- unique(unlist(chromatin_complexes_mouse, use.names = FALSE)[
  unlist(chromatin_complexes_mouse, use.names = FALSE) %in% available_genes_mouse])

# Run FindMarkers per cluster - Mouse
markers_list_mouse <- list()
for (cluster in levels(Idents(mGlio))) {
  markers <- tryCatch(
    FindMarkers(
      mGlio,
      ident.1         = cluster,
      assay           = "RNA",
      features        = chrom_genes_to_test_mouse,
      logfc.threshold = -Inf,
      min.pct         = 0,
      test.use        = "wilcox"
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(markers) && nrow(markers) > 0) {
    markers$cluster <- cluster
    markers$gene    <- rownames(markers)
    markers_list_mouse[[cluster]] <- markers
  }
}
chrom_markers_mouse <- do.call(rbind, markers_list_mouse)
rownames(chrom_markers_mouse) <- NULL
```

```{r}
library(dendsort)

# Pivot log2FC values into a gene x cluster matrix
log2fc_mat_hist_human <- hist_markers_human %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cluster, avg_log2FC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = avg_log2FC) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Reorder columns
log2fc_mat_hist_human <- log2fc_mat_hist_human[, col_order]

# --- handle NAs before clustering ---
# pivot_wider will introduce NA if a gene wasn't a marker in every cluster's
# results (common with FindMarkers/FindAllMarkers output). hclust/dist can't
# handle NAs, so impute to 0 (i.e., "no meaningful change") just for clustering.
mat_for_clustering <- log2fc_mat_hist_human
mat_for_clustering[is.na(mat_for_clustering)] <- 0

# --- cluster rows manually, then dendsort ---
row_dist  <- dist(mat_for_clustering)
row_clust <- hclust(row_dist, method = "complete")  # pheatmap's default method
row_clust <- dendsort(row_clust)

# Plot
png("hGlio_log2FC_hist_human.png", width = 8, height = 16, units = "in", res = 1200)
pheatmap(
  log2fc_mat_hist_human,
  cluster_rows  = row_clust,     # pass the dendsort'ed hclust object instead of TRUE
  cluster_cols  = FALSE,
  color         = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(100),
  breaks        = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),  # symmetric around 0
  border_color  = NA,
  fontsize_row  = 7,
  fontsize_col  = 11,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  main          = "Histone Modifiers — log2FC by GBM Subtype (Human)",
  na_col        = "grey85"       # visually flag genes missing log2FC in a cluster
)
dev.off()
```

```{r diag-heatmap-helper}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble)
library(pheatmap); library(RColorBrewer)

col_order <- c("PN", "MES", "CL", "MIX")

# Build gene x subtype log2FC matrix from a *_markers_* data frame, order rows
# diagonally (each gene assigned to its top subtype; weak genes dropped to a
# flat block at the bottom), and write a png.
plot_diag_heatmap <- function(markers_df, file, main,
                              col_order = c("PN", "MES", "CL", "MIX"),
                              enrich_thresh = 0.5,
                              breaks_lim = None {

  # pivot to gene x subtype
  mat <- markers_df %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, cluster, avg_log2FC) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = avg_log2FC) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
    as.matrix()

  # fail loudly if subtype labels don't match col_order (the usual silent killer)
  stopifnot(all(col_order %in% colnames(mat)))
  mat <- mat[, col_order]

  # diagonal row order
  row_order_diag <- mat %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "l2fc") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(l2fc, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE, na_rm = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cluster = ifelse(l2fc > enrich_thresh, cluster, "zzz_flat"),
      cluster = factor(cluster, levels = c(col_order, "zzz_flat"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cluster, dplyr::desc(l2fc)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)

  png(file, width = 8, height = 16, units = "in", res = 1200)
  pheatmap(
    mat[row_order_diag, ],
    cluster_rows  = FALSE,
    cluster_cols  = FALSE,
    scale         = "none",
    color         = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(100),
    breaks        = seq(-breaks_lim, breaks_lim, length.out = 101),
    border_color  = NA,
    fontsize_row  = 7, fontsize_col = 11,
    show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,
    main          = main
  )
  dev.off()

  invisible(mat)   # return the matrix in case you want it
}
```

```{r diag-heatmap-helper data modified breaks}

library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble)
library(pheatmap); library(RColorBrewer)

col_order <- c("PN", "MES", "CL", "MIX")

plot_diag_heatmap <- function(markers_df, file, main,
                              col_order = c("PN", "MES", "CL", "MIX"),
                              enrich_thresh = 0.5,
                              cap_quantile = 0.95) {   # <- saturate top/bottom 1%

  mat <- markers_df %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, cluster, avg_log2FC) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = avg_log2FC) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
    as.matrix()

  stopifnot(all(col_order %in% colnames(mat)))
  mat <- mat[, col_order]

  # --- data-driven symmetric cap ---
  lim  <- quantile(abs(mat), cap_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
  brks <- seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 101)
  message(main, " — cap at 95th pct: ±", round(lim, 2))   

  row_order_diag <- mat %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cluster", values_to = "l2fc") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(l2fc, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE, na_rm = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cluster = ifelse(l2fc > enrich_thresh, cluster, "zzz_flat"),
      cluster = factor(cluster, levels = c(col_order, "zzz_flat"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cluster, dplyr::desc(l2fc)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)

  png(file, width = 8, height = 16, units = "in", res = 1200)
  pheatmap(
    mat[row_order_diag, ],
    cluster_rows  = FALSE,
    cluster_cols  = FALSE,
    scale         = "none",
    color         = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(100),
    breaks        = brks,          # <- apply the cap
    border_color  = NA,
    fontsize_row  = 7, fontsize_col = 11,
    show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE,
    main          = main
  )
  dev.off()

  invisible(mat)
}
```

```{r}
# --- build a p_adj matrix aligned to the log2FC matrix ---
padj_mat_chrom_human <- chrom_markers_human %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cluster, p_val_adj) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = p_val_adj) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Force identical row + column order to the log2FC matrix (critical for alignment)
padj_mat_chrom_human <- padj_mat_chrom_human[
  rownames(log2fc_mat_chrom_human),
  colnames(log2fc_mat_chrom_human)
]

# --- build the asterisk matrix: enriched = padj < 0.05 AND log2FC over your cutoff ---
logfc_cutoff <- 0.5   # <-- set this to whatever you used in your selection step

sig_matrix <- matrix(
  "",
  nrow = nrow(log2fc_mat_chrom_human),
  ncol = ncol(log2fc_mat_chrom_human),
  dimnames = dimnames(log2fc_mat_chrom_human)
)

sig_idx <- padj_mat_chrom_human < 0.05 & log2fc_mat_chrom_human > logfc_cutoff
sig_idx[is.na(sig_idx)] <- FALSE          # NA/Inf cells never get an asterisk
sig_matrix[sig_idx] <- "*"
```

```{r, fig.height= 3, fig.width= 9}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

clean_feature <- function(p) {
  p +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title      = element_blank(),
      axis.text       = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
      axis.line       = element_blank()
    ) +
    annotation_custom(
      grob = segmentsGrob(
        x0 = unit(0.05, "npc"), x1 = unit(0.15, "npc"),  # horizontal arrow
        y0 = unit(0.05, "npc"), y1 = unit(0.05, "npc"),
        arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed"),
        gp = gpar(lwd = 2, col = "black", fill = "black")
      )
    ) +
    annotation_custom(
      grob = segmentsGrob(
        x0 = unit(0.05, "npc"), x1 = unit(0.05, "npc"),  # vertical arrow
        y0 = unit(0.05, "npc"), y1 = unit(0.15, "npc"),
        arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed"),
        gp = gpar(lwd = 2, col = "black", fill = "black")
      )
    ) +
    annotation_custom(
      grob = textGrob(
        "UMAP1", x = unit(0.10, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"),
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 5, col = "black")
      )
    ) +
    annotation_custom(
      grob = textGrob(
        "UMAP2", x = unit(0.02, "npc"), y = unit(0.10, "npc"),
        rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 5, col = "black")
      )
    )
}
```

```{r rank concordance}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)   # install.packages("ggrepel") if you don't have it

# ---- 1. Build the cross-species table for one arm (PN-vs-rest logFC) ----
# arg is `clust` not `cluster` to avoid colliding with the column name
build_concordance <- function(human_tbl, mouse_tbl, clust = "PN") {
  h <- human_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(cluster == clust) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(gene = toupper(gene),
                     lfc_human  = avg_log2FC,
                     pct1_human = pct.1, pct2_human = pct.2,
                     padj_human = p_val_adj)
  m <- mouse_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(cluster == clust) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(gene = toupper(gene),          # Smarcc1 -> SMARCC1
                     lfc_mouse  = avg_log2FC,
                     pct1_mouse = pct.1, pct2_mouse = pct.2,
                     padj_mouse = p_val_adj)
  dplyr::inner_join(h, m, by = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(lfc_human), is.finite(lfc_mouse))
}

# ---- 2. Correlation runner (Spearman + Kendall, optional gene exclusion) ----
run_concordance <- function(df, exclude = character(0), label = "") {
  d  <- dplyr::filter(df, !(gene %in% exclude))
  sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d$lfc_human, d$lfc_mouse, method = "spearman"))
  kn <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d$lfc_human, d$lfc_mouse, method = "kendall"))
  data.frame(set = label, n_genes = nrow(d),
             spearman_rho = unname(sp$estimate), spearman_p = sp$p.value,
             kendall_tau  = unname(kn$estimate),  kendall_p  = kn$p.value)
}

# ---- 3. Build both arms ----
conc_chrom <- build_concordance(chrom_markers_human, chrom_markers_mouse, "PN")
conc_hist  <- build_concordance(hist_markers_human,  hist_markers_mouse,  "PN")

sex_artefacts <- c("UTY", "KDM5D")   # Y-linked present-in-one-group artefacts (§6)

results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  run_concordance(conc_chrom, label = "Remodellers (PN)"),
  run_concordance(conc_hist,  label = "Histone (PN, all genes)"),
  run_concordance(conc_hist, exclude = sex_artefacts,
                  label = "Histone (PN, sex-linked removed)")
)
print(results)

# sanity: row counts should be ~class size (remodellers ~65-70, histone ~110-120)
cat("remodeller orthologs:", nrow(conc_chrom),
    " | histone orthologs:", nrow(conc_hist), "\n")

# ---- 4. Scatter (the figure — the point cloud IS the negative) ----
plot_concordance <- function(df, highlight, title, rho, tau) {
  df  <- dplyr::mutate(df, is_hl = gene %in% highlight)
  lim <- max(abs(c(df$lfc_human, df$lfc_mouse)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ggplot(df, aes(lfc_human, lfc_mouse)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = subset(df, !is_hl), colour = "grey65",
               size = 1.3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = subset(df,  is_hl), colour = "#B2182B", size = 2) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = subset(df, is_hl), aes(label = gene),
                             size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf,
                             min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.3) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
    labs(x = "Human PN log2FC (PN vs rest)",
         y = "Mouse PN log2FC (PN vs rest)",
         title = title,
         subtitle = sprintf("Spearman \u03c1 = %.2f   Kendall \u03c4 = %.2f", rho, tau)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

baf_hl  <- c("SMARCC1","SMARCC2","ARID1B","ARID2","SMARCA4","SMARCA2","SMARCD3","DPF1")
hist_hl <- c("EZH2","UTY","KDM5D","NCOA2","PRDM16")

r_chrom      <- run_concordance(conc_chrom)
r_hist_clean <- run_concordance(conc_hist)  # meaningful ρ/τ

p_chrom <- plot_concordance(conc_chrom, baf_hl,
             "Chromatin remodellers \u2014 cross-species PN specificity",
             r_chrom$spearman_rho, r_chrom$kendall_tau)

# histone subtitle uses the sex-removed value; the two artefact points stay
# labelled on the plot so the reader SEES why they were excluded
p_hist <- plot_concordance(conc_hist, hist_hl,
            "Histone modifiers \u2014 cross-species PN specificity",
            r_hist_clean$spearman_rho, r_hist_clean$kendall_tau)


p_chrom; p_hist
```



```{r}
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(ggrepel)

# --- membership sets straight from YOUR filtered tables (uppercased) ---
# histone
h_pass_H <- toupper(pn_human_hist$gene)
h_pass_M <- toupper(pn_mouse_hist$gene)
# remodeller
c_pass_H <- toupper(pn_human$gene)
c_pass_M <- toupper(pn_mouse$gene)

classify <- function(df, passH, passM) {
  df %>% mutate(
    grp = dplyr::case_when(
      gene %in% passH & gene %in% passM ~ "Both",
      gene %in% passH                   ~ "Human",
      gene %in% passM                   ~ "Mouse",
      TRUE                              ~ "ns"),
    grp = factor(grp, levels = c("ns","Human","Mouse","Both")))
}

conc_hist  <- classify(conc_hist,  h_pass_H, h_pass_M)
conc_chrom <- classify(conc_chrom, c_pass_H, c_pass_M)

grp_cols <- c(ns = "grey70", Human = "#B2182B", Mouse = "#2166AC", Both = "#8E44AD")



p_hist  <- plot_conc(conc_hist,  "Histone modifiers \u2014 cross-species PN specificity",  -0.03, -0.03) + theme(legend.position = "none") + labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
# recompute chrom rho/tau or reuse your run_concordance() output
rc <- run_concordance(conc_chrom)
p_chrom <- plot_conc(conc_chrom, "Chromatin remodellers \u2014 cross-species PN specificity",
                     rc$spearman_rho, rc$kendall_tau)  + theme(legend.position = "none") + labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL)
```

```{r plotting rank concordance function}

plot_conc <- function(df, title, rho, tau,
                      xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL,   # hard limits; NULL = auto
                      crop_q = 1,                 # e.g. 0.99 to auto-trim tails
                      keep_labels_outside = FALSE) {

  # --- decide limits ---
  auto_lim <- function(v) {
    m <- stats::quantile(abs(v), crop_q, na.rm = TRUE)  # crop_q=1 -> full range
    c(-m, m)
  }
  if (is.null(xlim)) xlim <- auto_lim(df$lfc_human)
  if (is.null(ylim)) ylim <- auto_lim(df$lfc_mouse)

  lab <- dplyr::filter(df, grp != "ns")
  if (!keep_labels_outside) {                     # don't label points off-panel
    lab <- dplyr::filter(lab,
      lfc_human >= xlim[1], lfc_human <= xlim[2],
      lfc_mouse >= ylim[1], lfc_mouse <= ylim[2])
  }

  ggplot(df, aes(lfc_human, lfc_mouse)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = subset(df, grp == "ns"), colour = "grey70",
               size = 1.3, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = subset(df, grp != "ns"), aes(colour = grp), size = 2.2) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = gene, colour = grp),
                             size = 3, show.legend = FALSE,
                             max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0,
                             segment.size = 0.3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols, breaks = c("Human","Mouse","Both"),
                        labels = c("Human only","Mouse only","Both species"),
                        name = "Passes logFC>0.5\n& adj-p<0.05 in") +
    coord_equal(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim) +       # clips view, keeps all data
    labs(x = "Human PN log2FC (PN vs rest)",
         y = "Mouse PN log2FC (PN vs rest)", title = title,
         subtitle = sprintf("Spearman \u03c1 = %.2f   Kendall \u03c4 = %.2f", rho, tau)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

```{r plotting rank concordance function better labelling}
plot_conc <- function(df, title, rho, tau, lim = 2, push = 0.85) {

  lab <- dplyr::filter(df, grp != "ns") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      off = abs(lfc_human) > lim | abs(lfc_mouse) > lim,   # outside the window?
      # clamp the *label anchor* to the frame, annotate real value if off-scale
      ax  = pmax(pmin(lfc_human, lim), -lim),
      ay  = pmax(pmin(lfc_mouse, lim), -lim),
      lab = ifelse(off,
                   sprintf("%s (%.1f, %.1f)", gene, lfc_human, lfc_mouse),
                   gene)
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(lfc_human, lfc_mouse)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = subset(df, grp == "ns"), colour = "grey70",
               size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = subset(df, grp != "ns"), aes(colour = grp), size = 2.2) +
    # triangles at the edge for the off-scale points
    geom_point(data = subset(lab, off), aes(ax, ay, colour = grp),
               shape = 17, size = 2.6) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = lab, aes(ax, ay, label = lab, colour = grp),
      size = 5, show.legend = FALSE,
      force = 3, force_pull = 0.2, box.padding = 0.6,
      max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0.5,
      segment.size = 0.2, segment.alpha = 0.4,
      seed = 42
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols, breaks = c("Human","Mouse","Both"),
                        labels = c("Human only","Mouse only","Both species"),
                        name = "Passes logFC>0.5\n& adj-p<0.05 in") +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = "Human PN log2FC (PN vs rest)",
         y = "Mouse PN log2FC (PN vs rest)", title = title,
         subtitle = sprintf("Spearman \u03c1 = %.2f   Kendall \u03c4 = %.2f", rho, tau)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

```{r}
# ---- Passing-hit FeaturePlots (supplement) --------------------------------
# Hits: PN, logFC > 0.5, adj-p < 0.05 (context doc §16)

hHits <- c(
  "KMT2C","KMT5A","EZH2",                       # HMTs
  "KDM1A","KDM4B","KDM5D","UTY",                # HDMs
  "NCOA1","NCOA2","KAT2B","ESCO1",              # HATs
  "HDAC4",                                      # HDACs
  "ARID2","SMARCC1","SMARCA4","SMARCD3","DPF1", # BAF
  "BAZ1A"                                       # ISWI
)  # 18

mHits <- c(
  "Suv39h1",                                    # HMT
  "Kdm6a","Kdm4c","Phf8","Uty","Kdm5d",         # HDMs
  "Ncoa2","Taf1",                               # HATs
  "Hdac9","Hdac8",                              # HDACs
  "Smarca2"                                     # remodeller
)  # 11

plot_hit_features <- function(obj, genes, assay = "RNA",
                              reduction = "wnn.umap",
                              ncol = 5, pt.size = 0.4) {
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- assay
  present <- intersect(genes, rownames(obj))
  missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(obj))
  if (length(missing))
    message("Not found, skipped: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

  plots <- lapply(present, function(g) {
    FeaturePlot(obj, features = g, reduction = reduction, order = TRUE,
                pt.size = pt.size, raster = FALSE) +
      scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "inferno") +
      ggtitle(g) +
      NoAxes() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10),
            legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
            legend.key.width  = unit(0.2, "cm"),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 6))
  })
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = ncol)
}

p_h <- plot_hit_features(hGlio, hHits, ncol = 5)
ggsave(paste0(plot_save, "SuppFig_hGlio_hit_featureplots.png"),
       p_h, width = 5 * 2.3, height = ceiling(length(hHits)/5) * 2.3,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")

p_m <- plot_hit_features(mGlio, mHits, ncol = 4)
ggsave(paste0(plot_save, "SuppFig_mGlio_hit_featureplots.png"),
       p_m, width = 4 * 2.3, height = ceiling(length(mHits)/4) * 2.3,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r feature with dimplot ref}
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")

d_m <- ref_dim(mGlio)
g_m <- plot_hit_features(mGlio, mHits, ncol = 4)
p_m <- d_m / g_m + plot_layout(heights = c(1, ceiling(length(mHits)/4)))

ggsave(paste0(plot_save, "SuppFig_mGlio_hit_featureplots_with_ref.png"),
       p_m, width = 4 * 2.3,
       height = (1 + ceiling(length(mHits)/4)) * 2.3,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r dotplot_helper}
plotPath <- paste0(projPath, "dotplots/")
dir.create(plotPath, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

plot_dot <- function(obj, features, title = NULL, file = NULL,
                     height = 8, width = 8, group = "Duy_clusters") {
  present <- features[features %in% rownames(obj)]
  missing <- setdiff(features, present)
  if (length(missing) > 0) message(title, " — not found: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  p <- DotPlot(obj, features = present, group.by = group) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = viridis::inferno(100))
  if (!is.null(title)) p <- p + ggtitle(title)
  if (!is.null(file)) ggsave(paste0(plotPath, file), p, height = height, width = width, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)
  p
}
```
